section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: Means adopted for committing Suicides Table VIII presents the statistics of suicidal deaths classified by the means adopted. The majority of the persons concerned took recourse to drowning, poisons and hanging for ending their lives, their percentage being 20.0 (21.3), 24.4 (21.3) and 16.4 (17.8) respectively of the total suicides committed in 1970. The percentages for 1969 are shown in the brackets. More persons adopted poison as the means for committing suicide in 1970, while the pattern as to the other means remained more or less the same as in the previous years. TABLE-VIII Incidence of Suicides in India by means Adopted, 1970
